Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
For the Petitioners: Mr. S.K. Murty, Advocate Mr. A.N. Deo, Advocate For the Uoi: Mr. Shiv Kumar
Sharma, Sr.

Panel Counsel For the State: Mr. Sachin Kumar, A.A.G.-Ii Ms. Sweta Shukla, A.C. to
A.A.G.-Ii Ms. Nirupama, A.C. to Sr. S.C.-Ii
---------
29/Dated: 11.09.2024
1.
It appears that the petitioners are claiming compensation referring to the Land Acquisition Act while the land has been acquired by Railways.
Under the Railways Act the entire provision is there.

Thus, the present writ petitions are not in accordance with law and the Court is not getting any assistance so far as the legal provisions are concerned.
2. The parties are at liberty to come prepared.
3. List these cases after ten weeks.
